facts.fact: UNDP says it supported digitalisation of civil registration in 18 communes of the Far North, North-West and South-West, and on 5 June 2026 deployed the SIGEC civil-status system at Bertoua city hall, producing the East Region's first digitised birth certificate, with seven East communes covered by the project.
facts.system: SIGEC (Systeme Integre de Gestion de l'Etat Civil)
